results.question: Who is Julie Wormser and what did she say about SSL in the 2020-21 annual report?
results.output: Julie Wormser is the Deputy Director of the Mystic River Watershed Association [1]. Regarding her assessment of the Sustainable Solutions Lab (SSL), Julie Wormser stated that Rebecca and SSL have been instrumental in closing the gap between climate practitioners focused on the built environment and BIPOC environmental justice practitioners focused on social resilience [1]. She cited the Climate Adaptation Forum (CAF) on climate migration as a perfect example of this work, describing the CAF as the most important forum for climate resilience practitioners in the Boston area [1]. Furthermore, she expressed gratitude for the existence of the forum [1].
